title: run the full go test suite outside the implementer's sandbox, or tell the implementer in the brief that socket tests will fail there, so it does not report 212 failures that pass in the reviewer session

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-230703-0874, project ork, item S417:

run the full go test suite outside the implementer's sandbox, or tell the implementer in the brief that socket tests will fail there, so it does not report 212 failures that pass in the reviewer session

Evidence: the implementer reported 4084 passed, 212 failed with "connect: operation not permitted"; in this reviewer session `go test ./...` passed for all 26 packages
